## Error contract

- Public failures use generated stable error codes and structured parameters. Provider and Tool raw response bodies, headers, credentials and stack traces are not part of the public error.
- Known mappings include Provider timeout/rate/context, Tool missing/execution, operation cancellation, Session not found/active Run, Permission denied, command payload conflict and protocol invalid/slow-consumer.
- CLI JSON diagnostics remain on stderr and use documented exit classes; Stage 1 implements input/internal behavior, with complete mapping continuing in later stages.

## Baseline procedure

The local publication gate produces JAR, POM, sources and javadoc in `build/stage1-repository`. `scripts/verify-stage1-consumer.ps1` creates a repository-external Gradle project which depends only on those artifacts and completes a deterministic two-turn Tool loop. `scripts/generate-api-baseline.mjs` uses the built JARs plus JDK `jar`/`javap` to generate [`0.1.0-signatures.json`](0.1.0-signatures.json), including top-level and nested public classes, constructors, methods, return types and parameters while excluding compiler-generated anonymous/builder implementation classes; `scripts/verify-api-baseline.mjs` regenerates it in a temporary directory and compares bytes. The Markdown contract and machine-readable signatures form the initial 0.x diff baseline; a binary compatibility promise starts at internal 1.0.
